UNCERTAINTY4.scope: Current-state recommendation evaluated on the fixed UNCERTAINTY4 source history; not its independent deployment policy.

statistics.scope: Evaluator mechanism measurement, warm-source-state population only. Four programs are not four independently deployed chronological policies; no new method or pure information-value claim.
